SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId, s.section_name AS sectionName, s.direction AS direction, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, sd.start_date_time, sd.end_date_time)) AS avgDurationSeconds, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM section_driving sd INNER JOIN section s ON sd.section_id = s.section_id
AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) >= 7 AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) < 9
AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) >= 17 AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) < 19
GROUP BY s.section_id, s.section_name, s.direction ORDER BY avgDurationSeconds DESC LIMIT #{topN}
SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId, s.path AS path FROM section s INNER JOIN route_station rs ON s.start_station_id = rs.station_id WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} ORDER BY rs.id
